description: Fresh held-out agent questions, written on 2026-10-02 after the router and the LLM system prompt were rebuilt from the dev questions and frozen, and before either system was scored on them. Frozen: the SHA-256 of this file is checked by tests/test_agent.py. y01 and y02 come from the external review and were known when the router's scope rules were written (known_before_rules = true). Before any scoring, x08 was rewritten (its first version asked for the cycle time at today's demand, where the queueing model has no finite value, so its gold was undefined) and the capex tool's hire roles were changed to singular nouns so that 'technician' and 'technicians' both match.
